name: Nicole Shorter
source:
Likes: silence, observing, Zigzag Punishment
Skills: being early to bed and early to rise, granting wishes
Role: NPC that leads humanity into depravity

A devil doll that appeared in Judgement 7's second game "Zigzag Dolls". He grants people 3 wishes in order to lead them astray down the path of desire, then carries out "Zigzag Punishment", taking away a part of the person's body proportional to the magnitude of their wishes. However, his presence is so insignificant that even Judgement 7 that had created the him can't recall his character setting in detail.

[Translated from [url=http://oreowa.jp/character/nicole.html]the official site[/url]]
